params.name: id
params.description:
The PodcastIndex Feed ID or IDs to search for.


If searching for multiple IDs, separate values with a comma. A maximum of 200 IDs can be provided.

params.name: since
params.description: Return items since the specified epoch timestamp.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: enclosure
params.description: The URL for the episode enclosure to get the information for.

params.name: fulltext
params.description:
If present, return the full text value of any text fields (ex: `description`).
If not provided, field value is truncated to 100 words.


Parameter shall not have a value

params.name: newest
params.description:
If present, returns only the most recent (newest) episode for each specified feed id.


Parameter shall not have a value

params.name: pretty
params.description:
If present, makes the output “pretty” to help with debugging.


Parameter shall not have a value

items.docs:
This call returns all the episodes we know about for this feed from the PodcastIndex ID.
Episodes are in reverse chronological order.


When using the `enclosure` parameter, only the episode matching the URL is returned.


Examples:

  - https://api.podcastindex.org/api/1.0/episodes/byfeedid?id=75075&pretty
  - https://api.podcastindex.org/api/1.0/episodes/byfeedid?id=41504,920666&pretty
  - https://api.podcastindex.org/api/1.0/episodes/byfeedid?id=75075&newest&pretty
  - https://api.podcastinde

params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: lang
params.description:
Specifying a language code (like "en") will return only episodes having that specific language.


You can specify multiple languages by separating them with commas.


If you also want to return episodes that have no language given, use the token "unknown". (ex. en,es,ja,unknown).


Values are not case sensitive.

params.name: cat
params.description:
Use this argument to specify that you **ONLY** want episodes with these categories in the results.


Separate multiple categories with commas.


You may specify either the Category ID and/or the Category Name.


Values are not case sensitive.


The `cat` and `notcat` filters can be used together to fine tune a very specific result set.


Category numbers and names can be found in the
[Podcast Namespace documentation](https://github.com/Podcastindex-org/podcast-namespace/blob/main/categories.json)

params.name: notcat
params.description:
Use this argument to specify categories of episodes to **NOT** show in the results.


Separate multiple categories with commas.


You may specify either the Category ID and/or the Category Name.


Values are not case sensitive.


The `cat` and `notcat` filters can be used together to fine tune a very specific result set.


Category numbers and names can be found in the
[Podcast Namespace documentation](https://github.com/Podcastindex-org/podcast-namespace/blob/main/categories.json)

This call returns a random batch of episodes, in no specific order.

  - https://api.podcastindex.org/api/1.0/episodes/random?max=2&pretty
